from pathlib import Path
import argparse, hashlib, json, subprocess

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Link the loading-pass diagnostic using fingerprint-matched libraries.')
parser.add_argument('--host-fingerprint', help='Exact Cargo host library directory name, e.g. baml_pack_host-7154125a2adf2a27')
args = parser.parse_args()

root = Path.cwd()
out = root / 'target/loading-passes-experiment-20261004'
previous = root / 'target/host-startup-profile-20261004'
fingerprints = root / 'target/release/.fingerprint'
paths = [p for p in fingerprints.glob('baml_pack_host-*/lib-baml_pack_host.json') if 'startup-experiment' in json.loads(p.read_text())['features']]
if args.host_fingerprint:
    paths = [p for p in paths if p.parent.name == args.host_fingerprint]
    assert len(paths) == 1, paths
host = max(paths, key=lambda p:p.stat().st_mtime)

def artifact(name, wanted):
    return next(p for p in fingerprints.glob(f'{name}-*/lib-{name}.json')
        if int.from_bytes(bytes.fromhex(p.with_suffix('').read_text()),'little') == wanted)

selected = {name:artifact(name,fp) for _,name,_,fp in json.loads(host.read_text())['deps'] if name!='build_script_build'}

from pathlib import Path
import json,struct,subprocess
root=Path.cwd()
out=root/'target/loading-passes-experiment-20261004'
fps=root/'target/release/.fingerprint'
build=json.loads((out/'build-metadata.json').read_text())
selected={k:Path(v) for k,v in build['libraries'].items()}
def dependency(owner,name):
    wanted=next(fp for _,n,_,fp in json.loads(selected[owner].read_text())['deps'] if n==name)
    return next(p for p in fps.glob(f'{name}-*/lib-{name}.json') if int.from_bytes(bytes.fromhex(p.with_suffix('').read_text()),'little')==wanted)
selected['bex_vm_types']=dependency('bex_engine','bex_vm_types')
selected['serde_json']=dependency('bex_vm_types','serde_json')
cmd=['rustc','--edition=2024','-C','opt-level=3','-C','lto=thin','-C','codegen-units=1',str(out/'validation_probe.rs'),'-o',str(out/'validation-probe'),'-L',f'dependency={root}/target/release/deps']
for name in ['bex_vm_types','serde_json','baml_exec','baml_artifact']:
    cmd+=['--extern',f'{name}={root}/target/release/deps/lib{selected[name].parent.name}.rlib']
(out/'validation-build.json').write_text(json.dumps({'command':cmd,'libraries':{k:str(selected[k]) for k in ['bex_vm_types','serde_json','baml_exec','baml_artifact']}},indent=2))
subprocess.run(cmd,check=True)
binary=(out/'empty').read_bytes()
magic,_,_,_,ncmds,_,_,_=struct.unpack_from('<IiiIIIII',binary)
assert magic==0xfeedfacf
cursor=32
sections=[]
for _ in range(ncmds):
    command,size=struct.unpack_from('<II',binary,cursor)
    if command==0x19:
        section_count=struct.unpack_from('<I',binary,cursor+64)[0]
        for index in range(section_count):
            fields=struct.unpack_from('<16s16sQQIIIIIIII',binary,cursor+72+80*index)
            if fields[0].rstrip(b'\0')==b'baaaaaaaaaaaaaml':
                sections.append(binary[fields[4]:fields[4]+fields[3]])
    cursor+=size
assert len(sections)==1
(out/'envelope.bamlart').write_bytes(sections[0])
result=subprocess.run([str(out/'validation-probe'),str(out/'envelope.bamlart')],capture_output=True)
assert result.returncode==0,result.stderr.decode()
(out/'validation-checks.json').write_bytes(result.stdout)
checks=json.loads(result.stdout)
print(len(checks['checks']),'validation comparisons passed',checks['valid_program_allocation_requests'],flush=True)
